templates.why_chosen: A numbered, dual-workflow hub-spoke where colour distinguishes download from distribution steps, though the record itself flags the Client-to-HyperEdge-Device shortcut arrow as breaking a clean hub-and-spoke shape.
templates.what_to_learn: Overlay two workflows on one architecture with a two-line colour legend (blue download, orange distribution) reusing the same three boxes for both; this exemplar's own weakness is a direct Client-Device link that bypasses the Tracker hub, and numbering that restarts per workflow.
